content.title: Who We Are Looking For
paragraphs: Mōchirīī recruits players in Asia Pacific who want organized events, practical build discussion, progression support & dependable guild coordination.
Invite players whose schedules and goals fit the guild. Explain our UTC+8 event windows, Discord onboarding, conduct standards & participation expectations before they apply.

Recruitment quality matters more than message volume. Answer questions accurately, avoid pressure, and direct interested players to mochirii.com or Discord so they receive the same current information.

Playing together is the clearest introduction to the guild. Form parties, communicate objectives, explain mechanics when asked & follow through on the event plan. Good coordination shows prospective members how the guild operates.
Retention depends on useful onboarding. Help new members find event schedules, build resources, leadership contacts & the correct channels for questions or moderation concerns.

Members who recruit represent Mōchirīī in public spaces. Follow platform rules, do not spam, do not promise ranks or rewards & never speak on behalf of leadership about a policy you have not confirmed.

Leadership reviews membership through participation, conduct, reliability & contribution over time. Consistent members may take on mentoring, event coordination or leadership responsibilities as needs arise.
conclusion: Build the guild through accurate invitations, reliable event participation & direct support for new members.
